text: Safe as a 'no change, record and track' item. Adult-enabled endings are not a safety risk in themselves, and a supportive adult is a protective model for 3-6. Two cautions if this ever becomes guidance: the adult must enable, not rescue-by-dismissal (no 'stop crying, it's nothing'), and Masal ailem adults are real family members, so their in-story role must never be shaming, threatening or a source of the problem. Tracking agency needs no child data; it is a corpus annotation.
